body: Your stated oracle requires GraphHsmm to reject a custom model returning unreachable or unassessable for a readable source. I added the executable court: unreachable is currently accepted, then filtered. Rejecting it is straightforward. Unassessable conflicts with existing LAW 3, which requires lawful zero-support DefaultLocalCostModel weights to infer Right while preserving readable-source Unassessable audit rows. At the LocalCostModel boundary there is no truthful way to distinguish an identical custom Unassessable value from the default result. Please identify the exact observable distinction your oracle expects: reject only Unreachable; introduce a typed producer outcome/proof; or change LAW 3. I will not invent model identity or break the lawful zero-support case without an explicit ruling.
